events.region: Isle of Wight
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, up to one half foot of
inundation above ground level expected in low-lying areas near
shorelines and tidal waterways. For the Coastal Flood Watch,
up to one foot of inundation above ground level possible in
low- lying areas near shorelines and tidal waterways.

* WHERE...Isle of Wight County.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 2 PM Monday to 6
AM EDT Tuesday. For the Coastal Flood Watch, from Tuesday
afternoon through Wednesday morning.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
may be inundated. Some shoreline erosion may occur.
